evaluation_scope: Per-pack Zitadel deployment + identity-related K8s resources

5.1.1_minimum_rbac.evidence: ServiceAccount per ADR-0148 SPIFFE binding; no cluster-admin

5.1.2_minimize_secret_access.evidence: Chart declares no Role, ClusterRole or RoleBinding at all, so no subject is granted get/list/watch on Secrets — which is what CIS 5.1.2 measures. Credentials reach the pod by secretKeyRef injection (deployment.yaml:52-60), the pattern CIS recommends precisely because it avoids Secrets API access, and the masterkey via OpenBao CSI (deployment.yaml:112-117). Corrected 2026-07-26: an earlier revision marked this failing by disproving the previous evidence string ('no K8s Secret leakage') rather than the control itself.

5.2.1_minimize_privileged_container.evidence: Zitadel pod runs as non-root per ADR-0146 distroless-nonroot

5.2.8_apparmor_profile.evidence: CONTRADICTED 2026-07-26: no AppArmor annotation or appArmorProfile field anywhere under oya/identity/iac/helm/; the chart sets seccomp only

5.4.1_image_signed.evidence: CONTRADICTED 2026-07-26: this workload runs ghcr.io/zitadel/zitadel (values.yaml:11), and neither Kyverno verifyImages policy matches it — infra/kyverno/policies/verify-image-signed.yaml scopes to registry.oya-registry.svc.cluster.local:5000/* and require-signed-images.yaml to ghcr.io/oyatie/*. No cosign verification covers this image. (Separately, the buildkit signing job cannot execute at all — jq and curl are absent from moby/buildkit — but that pipeline does not build this image.)

5.4.2_image_pinned_by_digest.evidence: CONTRADICTED 2026-07-26: values.yaml:9 comments 'Pinned by digest per ADR-0181' directly above tag: v2.55.0 (values.yaml:12) with no digest field present. Repo-wide, exactly ONE image reference is digest-pinned and 85 values.yaml ship an empty digest.

5.4.3_image_distroless_or_minimal_base.evidence: Zitadel distroless image; oyatie µservices per ADR-0146

5.7.3_pod_security_standards_enforced.evidence: CONTRADICTED 2026-07-26: the sole Kyverno ClusterPolicy scopes all rules to namespaces: ["cloud-k8s-system"], while identity deploys to identity-{{ .Values.packLabel }}, so the policy never matches this workload
